This corpus is entirely invented. Nothing here describes a real device, a real
address, or a real service.

## What lives here

The synthetic estate has three boxes and a monitoring stack that watches them.
Every address in this tree is a documentation placeholder in the example range
`10.0.0.0/24`.

## Reading order

Start at the device pages, then the service pages. The runbook is long on purpose.
